description: Source code for managing persistent notifications in Mattermost, including functions to resolve, delete, send, and process persistent notifications, as well as auxiliary data handling and notification logic.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for managing persistent notifications.

methods.name: ResolvePersistentNotification
methods.description: Stops persistent notifications for a post if a user reacts, replies, or acknowledges, excluding the post owner.

methods.name: DeletePersistentNotification
methods.description: Stops persistent notifications for a specific post.

methods.name: SendPersistentNotifications
methods.description: Fetches and sends persistent notifications for posts exceeding the notification interval.

methods.name: forEachPersistentNotificationPost
methods.description: Iterates over posts with persistent notifications, applying a callback function.

methods.name: persistentNotificationsAuxiliaryData
methods.description: Prepares auxiliary data like groups, profiles, keywords, and notify props for channels.

methods.name: channelTeamMapsForPosts
methods.description: Retrieves channel and team mappings for a list of posts.

methods.name: sendPersistentNotifications
methods.description: Sends notifications for a post to mentioned users, including push and desktop notifications.

methods.name: persistentNotificationsAllowedForStatus
methods.description: Checks if persistent notifications are allowed based on user status.

methods.name: IsPersistentNotificationsEnabled
methods.description: Determines if persistent notifications are enabled based on configuration and post priority settings.
